content: Hello! This is Jamie from Pawsitive Care. How can I assist you with your pet's needs today?
Hi, I'm a bit worried because I noticed my dog seems anxious after the last grooming session. Is everything okay?
I completely understand your concern. I reassure you that our team always handles pets with the utmost care and attention. Can you tell me more about what you've observed?
She's been avoiding her favorite spots and seems more restless than usual. I'm not sure if something happened during grooming.
Don't worry, your dog's safety and comfort are our top priorities. Sometimes pets react differently after grooming, but I assure you we follow strict safety protocols to prevent any distress.
That's comforting to hear. Is there anything I should do at home to help her feel better?

Absolutely. Giving her extra attention and a calm environment can help a lot. Also, if you notice any unusual behavior persisting, please contact us immediately. You can trust me to support you and your pet.
Thanks, Jamie. I appreciate you taking the time to explain and reassure me.
You're very welcome! We're here for you and your furry friend whenever you need assistance.
